basics.name: Damien Dormal
basics.label: Staff Software Engineer
basics.summary: Pragmatic Staff Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience building and scaling distributed systems in fintech. Deep expertise in card issuing platforms, IDV/KYC, and bank/network integrations powering millions of customers at Cash App and Square. Product-minded technical leader who bridges engineering, compliance, and business stakeholders. Proven track record as both IC and Engineering Manager. Proficient with AI-augmented engineering workflows.

work.name: Cash App / Block
highlights: Led the accounts stream for Block's VISA DPS integration, designing issuer-agnostic APIs and executing a 34M-record data migration
Architected a scalable program construct to manage Block's growing card issuing portfolio across multiple sponsor banks
Coordinated 4+ teams on Bancorp reporting compliance, securing bank approval and unblocking the DPS launch timeline
Championed AI-augmented engineering workflows, running weekly AI mob sessions and driving large-scale codebase refactors with agentic tooling

work.name: Cash App / Block
highlights: Founded and grew the New Markets team into a T-shaped org owning account management and card program infrastructure (3-5 engineers)
Led the 3DS/ACS initiative end-to-end — from PCI DSS certification through network integration to production rollout for Cash App and Square Card
Designed and built the Card Programs Store, a centralized service to manage Block's growing portfolio of card programs across issuers
Drove KYC modernization and supported new card program launches across multiple geographies (US, Canada, UK)
Authored the team's strategic roadmap and made the business case for team expansion

work.name: Cash App / Block
highlights: Enabled the launch of Cash Teen / Sponsored accounts across issuing programs, driving key changes in the KYC pipeline
Designed a simplified KYC storage architecture, replacing a complex multi-service proxy flow and enabling partner bank reporting
Extended the accounts platform to support multi-issuer customer accounts for both Cash App and Square

work.name: Envato
highlights: Designed and developed a new API to distribute content across the organisation, enabling downstream teams to consume assets programmatically
Led decomposition of a monolith application into services, extracting key functionalities into independently deployable microservices
Led infrastructure and DevOps improvements within the group, organising and facilitating monthly infrastructure catchups

work.name: Locomote
highlights: Developed the booking tool (Node.js) and travel management platform (Rails) serving enterprise customers
Transformed the booking tool to support multiple booking APIs, enabling the platform to aggregate travel suppliers
Supported engineers and hired new staff, improving developer engagement through cross-team meetings

work.name: Moko Social Media
highlights: Built the API for Speakiesy, an intramural social app launched to 100+ college campuses (Rails)
Introduced new DevOps strategy using Docker and AWS ECS, modernizing the deployment pipeline

work.name: Cinglevue
highlights: Developed the system back-end (REST API) and front-end (Backbone.js, Bootstrap), establishing BDD testing with Cucumber and Selenium
Created a proof of concept for a new client-side stack (Backbone.js, Handlebars.js, Require.js) that became the company standard
